entries.finding: When a large natural section has already failed after two materially different preservation-clean production rewrites—one structural/minimum-dose and one holistic authorial-register reconstruction—with both Pangram-4 results at AI 1.0 High confidence across the full boundary, broad model-only style regeneration is not an evidence-based gradient. Stop that lane and require genuinely fresh owner language or another independently human same-content realization before more detector-driven rewriting.
entries.reason: Somatic Therapies r03 and r04 provide a negative replication across materially different faithful production strategies on the same stable Job2-to-end boundary. The rule prevents wasting paid calls and, more importantly, prevents pseudo-owner prose after model-only realization has shown no detector movement.

entries.finding: After two preservation-clean model-only Job2-to-end variants measured Pangram Human 0.0, the first candidate built from genuinely fresh owner semantic evidence measured Human 0.0570 and produced two High-confidence Human islands aligned with directly retained owner-derived material, while one High-confidence AI window still covered most of the downstream boundary.
entries.reason: This supports the existing owner-realization/source-provenance lessons and changes the Somatic next action, but one long-context article boundary cannot establish sentence-level causality or a general detector rule. Replication across other fresh-owner reconstructions would be needed before promotion.

entries.finding: Somatic r06 added materially more fresh owner semantic evidence and source rollback after r05; Pangram Human fraction increased from 0.0570 to 0.08345 and a new High-confidence Human island appeared on the near-direct housemate/self-Brainspotting setup, while model-realized versions of the new owner material still occupied a long High-confidence AI window.
entries.reason: This strengthens the article-specific hypothesis that fresh owner realization/provenance matters more than model realization of the same owner semantics, but r06 alone cannot establish a general detector rule because the boundary is long and interactive. r07 is the preregistered lower-dose owner-wording test that can materially sharpen or falsify that interpretation.

entries.finding: A long Pangram AI window can contain near-direct current owner prose even when adjacent owner passages in the same boundary are High-confidence Human. In Somatic r07b, restoring much more of Joel's actual wording raised the whole Job2-to-end Human fraction from r06's 0.08345 to 0.16262, yet the long AI window began mid-owner Shaking explanation and swallowed direct owner qigong, Brainspotting, EMDR, and neurological-dearmoring material. Therefore a red contextual window is localization evidence for the whole composition, not sentence-level authority to rewrite the owner prose inside it.
entries.reason: This extends the existing window/localization and source-provenance lessons with a production counterexample: current owner wording itself can be classified inside a larger AI window while other owner wording in the same exact boundary is Human. The rule prevents detector-driven erasure of higher-authority prose and gives a clear stop condition for the final section call.

entries.finding: Structural-operation approval does not imply wording approval: after Joel approves a move, consolidation, deletion, compression, or routing change, later humanization should target only surviving assistant realization, preserve untouched owner prose, and prefer minimum-dose rollback to actual owner language over fresh model imitation when the approved function can still be performed.
Stacked editorial closure can be detector-sensitive through boundary-level feature interactions even when isolated operations are null; preserve owner source and avoid phrase blacklists.

In exact Human M01, compact neutral-witness-only and borrowed-adulthood-only paragraphs each independently crossed Pangram's boundary to Mixed, rejecting adjacency-only causation at this boundary and requiring architectural routing or higher-authority realization rather than token hunting.
entries.reason: The preregistered two-call split decisively changes the Somatic production route. The scope remains exact-boundary and realization-specific, so the promotion explicitly forbids phrase bans and preserves both protected functions.

entries.finding: The split reservation ledger records exact call accounting and evidence paths already interpreted in the experiment results.
